name: Family & employment counsel (category guide)
summary: For tenancy deposit fights, SCT limits, ROM/LTVP affidavits, wills/probate, and employment contracts — use qualified Singapore counsel.
body: Do not crowdsource tenancy deposit fights on Facebook alone. Small Claims Tribunals only cover residential leases not exceeding two years, claims within published monetary limits, and respondents servable in Singapore — overseas landlords and back-to-back renewals are common Reddit failure modes. A one-hour consult with a Singapore solicitor often clarifies leverage faster than a month of group-chat anxiety. For LTVP common-law affidavits and apostille sequencing, pair counsel with the notary / SAL pipeline rather than paying overseas character-based translation quotes first. For foreigner marriages under the Women’s Charter and for Singapore bank probate (resealing vs fresh grant), treat Reddit checklists as orientation only — domicile and foreign-law affidavits are solicitor work. CPF nominations sit outside wills; ask counsel to confirm your estate plan covers both rails.
